Pre-Nursery to UKG

The right challenge. At the right age. With room to be a child.

Kabira’s programs follow the way young children grow: from comfort and communication to confident school readiness.

Find your child’s stage →View admissions →

Age at a glance

A clear path through the early years.

Age ranges are guides. Suitable placement is confirmed during the admission interaction.

2+Pre-Nursery3+Nursery4+LKG5+UKG
2+

Pre-Nursery

Comfort before confidence.

A gentle introduction to school where children settle, connect, communicate, and discover through play.

  • Communication and listening
  • Colours, shapes, stories, and rhymes
  • Sensory exploration
  • Fine and gross motor development
  • Socialisation and self-help
Discuss this stage →
3+

Nursery

Curiosity finds language.

Children become more expressive while early concepts, creativity, and growing independence take shape.

  • Pre-reading and sound awareness
  • Early numeracy
  • Vocabulary and conversation
  • Art, music, and movement
  • Social-emotional development
Discuss this stage →
4+

LKG

Readiness with room to play.

A stronger foundation in language and number concepts, balanced with expression, movement, and discovery.

  • Phonics and letter sounds
  • Blending and early reading readiness
  • Number concepts and logical thinking
  • Writing readiness
  • Communication and life skills
Discuss this stage →
5+

UKG

A confident bridge to primary school.

Children strengthen academic readiness, independence, and the ability to express ideas with clarity.

  • Reading fluency and blending
  • Sentence and writing development
  • Number operations and reasoning
  • Environmental awareness
  • Creativity, confidence, and independence
Discuss this stage →

How children learn

Learning that moves, speaks, builds, and wonders.

Every concept is supported by active experiences that help children understand and remember.

PlayExplorationConversationStorytellingNatureMusicMovementHands-on discovery

Language & literacy

Pronunciation, vocabulary, listening, speaking, phonics, reading, and writing readiness.

Thinking & numeracy

Number concepts, patterns, comparison, problem-solving, and logical reasoning.

Body & creativity

Movement, coordination, art, music, rhythm, imagination, and self-expression.

Self & community

Emotions, relationships, independence, life skills, culture, and positive values.

A day at Kabira

A familiar rhythm. Something new every day.

  1. 01Arrive & belong

    Welcome, settle, explore, and connect.

  2. 02Discover & discuss

    Circle time and interactive concepts.

  3. 03Move & share

    Snack, social time, and active play.

  4. 04Create & reflect

    Stories, art, music, role play, and goodbye.
